The anchor, positive and negative must be equidistant from each other.
why: margin 是一个硬间隔：positive 一旦比 negative 近了这个间隔，该三元组 loss 归零、不再产生梯度；代价是要不停挖新的难三元组才有得学。
why_en: The margin is a hard gap — once the positive is already closer than the negative by that margin, the triplet's loss hits zero and stops producing gradient, so you must keep mining harder triplets to keep learning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 三元组损失：要求锚点到正样本的距离比到负样本近至少一个 margin。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Triplet loss requires the anchor to be closer to its positive than to its negative by at least a margin.

termDefinitions.meaning: 间隔：损失函数要求的最小距离差，达到后就不再施加梯度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The margin is the minimum distance gap the loss demands; once met, it stops applying gradient.

termDefinitions.meaning: 锚点：三元组里作为参照的那个样本，另外两个都相对它度量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The anchor is the reference sample in a triplet; the other two are measured relative to it.

optionExplanations: 对：只要求相对关系达标就停手，不追求绝对距离数值。
压到 0 会把同一个人的所有照片塌成一点，姿态光照的变化全被抹掉。
无上界地推远会让优化发散，margin 正是为了给它一个停止点。
等距等于不区分正负，训练信号直接消失。
optionExplanations_en: Right: only the relative relation has to be satisfied — no absolute distance target is chased.
Collapsing it to zero would fuse all photos of a person into one point, erasing pose and lighting variation.
Pushing away without bound makes optimization diverge; the margin exists precisely to give it a stopping point.
Equidistance means no distinction between positive and negative, so the training signal vanishes.

scenario: 两塔训练想挖 hard negative——模型当前认为相关、其实不相关的候选。挖它要对全量候选做最近邻检索。
scenario_en: Two-tower training wants hard negatives — candidates the current model thinks are relevant but aren't. Mining them requires a nearest-neighbour search over the full candidate set.
q: 为什么不能每个训练步都重新挖一次 hard negative？
q_en: Why can't you re-mine hard negatives at every training step?
options: 最近邻索引本身不支持任何增量更新
索引建在当前模型的向量上，而向量每步都在变
hard negative 会让 loss 不收敛，只能少量使用
候选库太大，向量根本存不下
options_en: The nearest-neighbour index supports no incremental updates at all.
The index is built from the current model's vectors, and those vectors change every step.
Hard negatives keep the loss from converging, so they must be used sparingly.
The candidate set is too large for its vectors to be stored at all.
why: 索引由当前向量建成，一步梯度就让它过期；生产做法是每几千步用冻结快照重挖一批混进 batch，中间靠批内负样本顶着，代价是负样本略微陈旧。
why_en: The index is built from today's vectors and one gradient step stales it, so production mines from a frozen snapshot every few thousand steps and leans on in-batch negatives in between — the cost is slightly stale negatives.

termDefinitions.meaning: 难负样本：模型当前打分很高、实际上不相关的候选，最能推动质量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hard negative is a candidate the current model scores highly but that is actually irrelevant, and it drives most of the quality gain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一个 batch 里属于别的 query 的候选，可以白拿来当负样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In-batch negatives are the other queries' candidates inside the same batch, used as free negatives.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索：牺牲一点召回率换取大规模向量检索的低延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN stands for Approximate Nearest Neighbor search, which trades a little recall for low-latency retrieval over huge vector sets.

optionExplanations: 索引当然能重建，卡点不在能不能更新，而在它依据的向量已经变了。
对：向量每步都动，昨天挖出来的“难”负样本今天可能已经不难了。
hard negative 恰恰是质量的主要来源，问题只在挖它的时机和成本。
候选向量本来就要全量入索引才能 serving，存储不是这里的瓶颈。
optionExplanations_en: An ANN index can certainly be rebuilt; the blocker isn't updatability but that the vectors it was built from have moved.
Right: the vectors shift every step, so yesterday's hard negative may not be hard at all today.
Hard negatives are the main source of quality — the only question is when and how expensively you mine them.
Every candidate vector has to be indexed for serving anyway, so storage is not the bottleneck here.

scenario: 社交图规模稳定、很少加新节点，你打算用 node2vec 给每个用户学一个向量。
scenario_en: Your social graph is stable and rarely gains new nodes, and you plan to learn a vector for each user with node2vec.
q: node2vec 靠什么把图变成训练信号？
q_en: How does node2vec turn a graph into a training signal?
options: 做偏置随机游走，把序列喂进 word2vec 目标
对整张邻接矩阵做特征值分解，取前 k 个特征向量
逐层聚合邻居特征，学一个能泛化到新节点的函数
先对节点度数和标签做人工分桶，再 one-hot 编码
options_en: It runs biased random walks and feeds the sequences into a word2vec objective.
It eigendecomposes the full adjacency matrix and keeps the top k eigenvectors.
It aggregates neighbour features layer by layer to learn a function that generalizes to new nodes.
It buckets nodes by degree and label, then one-hot encodes them.
why: node2vec 把图当语料：游走序列相当于句子，反复共现的节点相当于上下文词；代价是它是 transductive 的，新节点没被游走过就没有向量。
why_en: node2vec treats the graph as a corpus — walks are sentences and co-occurring nodes are context words; the cost is that it's transductive, so a new node has no vector until you retrain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通过偏置随机游走生成节点序列，再用 word2vec 目标学节点向量的方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: node2vec generates node sequences with biased random walks and learns node vectors with a word2vec objective.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从上下文共现学词向量的经典目标，共现越多向量越近。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: word2vec is the classic objective that learns word vectors from context co-occurrence — the more they co-occur, the closer the vectors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只为训练时见过的节点产出向量，新节点必须重训才有。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A transductive method produces vectors only for nodes seen during training; new nodes need a retrain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个实体独占一个维度、只有该位为 1 的稀疏表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: One-hot encoding gives each entity its own dimension, with a single 1 and the rest zeros.

optionExplanations: 对：游走把图结构压成序列，之后完全复用文本那一套训练目标。
特征值分解是谱方法的路子，node2vec 没有走矩阵分解这条线。
这是 GraphSAGE 这类 inductive 方法的做法，图不断长新节点时它才更合适。
人工分桶回到 one-hot 的老问题：没有共享结构，也不表达邻接关系。
optionExplanations_en: Right: walks flatten graph structure into sequences, after which the text training objective is reused as-is.
Eigendecomposition is the spectral-methods route; node2vec does not go through matrix factorization.
That describes inductive methods like GraphSAGE, which win instead when the graph keeps gaining new nodes.
Manual bucketing returns to the one-hot problem: no shared structure and no expression of adjacency.

scenario: 语义搜索原型两周要 demo，文档 5 万篇；半年后若上线要覆盖十亿级文档并按点击日志微调。
scenario_en: A semantic search prototype must demo in two weeks over 50K documents; if it ships, in six months it must cover a billion documents and be fine-tuned on click logs.
q: 向量该用托管 API 还是自托管模型来产出？
q_en: Should the embeddings come from a hosted API or a self-hosted model?
options: 全程用第三方托管 API，省下所有运维成本
原型用托管 API，规模上来后转自托管
一开始就自己从零训 encoder，不碰第三方
两条路并行，长期同时维护两套向量
options_en: Use a third-party hosted API the whole way and save all the operational work.
Prototype on the hosted API, then move to self-hosting once scale arrives.
Train your own encoder from scratch from day one and avoid third parties.
Run both paths in parallel and maintain two sets of vectors long-term.
why: 托管 API 上手最快，但按调用计费、也不能在自己数据上微调；量级和微调需求这两条一起把答案推向自托管。
why_en: A hosted API gets you moving fastest, but it bills per call and you can't fine-tune it on your data — scale and the fine-tuning need together push you toward self-hosting.
tradeoff: 托管 API 的上手速度 vs 自托管的成本控制与可微调
whenOtherWins: 如果长期量级都不大、也没有领域微调需求，一直用托管 API 是更省人力的选择。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把原始输入映射成固定长度向量的那部分模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An encoder is the part of the model that maps raw input into a fixed-length vector.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在预训练模型权重的基础上，用自己任务的数据继续训练一小段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fine-tuning continues training a pre-trained model's weights on your own task-specific data.

optionExplanations: 十亿级文档按调用计费很快贵过自建，而且始终没法在自家点击数据上微调。
对：原型期买速度，规模期买成本和微调能力，切换点由量级决定。
从零训会把两周的 demo 拖成几个月，通用英文语义本来就有人训好了。
两套向量落在不同空间，没法互相比较，运维和评估都要做双份。
optionExplanations_en: At a billion documents, per-call billing overtakes self-hosting fast, and you still can never fine-tune on your own click data.
Right: buy speed during the prototype and cost plus fine-tunability at scale — the switch point is set by volume.
Training from scratch turns a two-week demo into months, and general English semantics is already trained for you.
Two sets of vectors live in different spaces and can't be compared, doubling both operations and evaluation.

scenario: 电商搜索里用户既搜“适合送妈妈的礼物”这类语义查询，也搜精确型号“iPhone 15 Pro 256G”。
scenario_en: In e-commerce search, users type semantic queries like "a good gift for my mum" as well as exact model strings like "iPhone 15 Pro 256G".
q: 召回层该只用向量语义检索吗？
q_en: Should the retrieval layer use vector semantic search alone?
options: 只用向量检索，语义模型也能覆盖精确匹配
只用关键词检索，语义查询靠同义词词典补
语义召回与关键词召回并行，再融合结果
先跑关键词检索，无结果时才退回向量检索
options_en: Vector search only — the semantic model can cover exact matching too.
Keyword search only, patching semantic queries with a synonym dictionary.
Run semantic and keyword retrieval in parallel, then fuse the results.
Run keyword search first and fall back to vector search only when it returns nothing.
why: 向量懂“意思”但记不住确切型号，关键词正好反过来；生产语义搜索几乎都是两路并行再融合，代价是多一套索引和一层融合排序要调。
why_en: Vectors understand meaning but blur exact model strings, and keywords are the mirror image, so production semantic search is almost always hybrid — at the cost of a second index and a fusion ranking layer to tune.
tradeoff: 语义召回的泛化 vs 词法召回的精确匹配
whenOtherWins: 如果查询几乎全是自然语言问句、没有型号编号类精确查询，纯向量召回够用且少一套索引。

termDefinitions.meaning: 同时跑向量语义召回和关键词词法召回，再把两路结果融合排序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hybrid retrieval runs vector semantic recall and keyword lexical recall together, then fuses and ranks both result sets.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按字面词项匹配的传统关键词检索，不理解含义但精确。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Lexical retrieval is traditional keyword matching on literal terms — it doesn't understand meaning but it is exact.

optionExplanations: 向量会把 iPhone 15 Pro 和 iPhone 14 Pro 压得很近，型号数字被抹平。
同义词词典要人肉维护，覆盖不到和商品没有共同词的礼物类查询。
对：两路各补对方的盲区，融合后再统一排序。
退回式只在关键词零结果时才用语义，有结果的查询永远吃不到语义召回。
optionExplanations_en: Vectors place iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 14 Pro extremely close together, smearing out the model number.
A synonym dictionary needs manual upkeep and still can't cover gift queries that share no words with the product.
Right: each path covers the other's blind spot, and one ranking pass merges them.
A fallback only fires when keywords return nothing, so any query with results never benefits from semantic recall.

scenario: 召回要在 10 亿候选向量里取 top-100，在线延迟预算不到 100ms。
scenario_en: Retrieval must return the top 100 out of a billion candidate vectors within an online latency budget under 100ms.
q: 为什么不直接精确扫描全部向量算相似度？
q_en: Why not just scan every vector exactly and compute similarity?
options: 精确扫描要遍历 10 亿向量，延迟远超预算
精确扫描算出的最近邻不如近似的准确
余弦相似度在 CPU 上无法批量计算出结果
向量维度太高时精确距离没有数学定义
options_en: Exact scanning touches all one billion vectors and blows past the latency budget.
Exact scanning finds less accurate neighbours than approximate search does.
Cosine similarity cannot be computed in batches on a CPU.
Exact distance has no mathematical definition at high dimensionality.
why: 近似检索用 HNSW 图或 IVF 分区只探索一小部分向量，把线性扫描压进预算；代价是 recall 不到 100%，探索量越低漏掉真正最近邻的概率越大。
why_en: Approximate search explores only a fraction of the vectors through an HNSW graph or IVF partitions, squeezing a linear scan into budget — the cost is recall below 100%, and the less you explore the more true neighbours you miss.
tradeoff: 召回率 recall vs 检索延迟
whenOtherWins: 候选只有几万条时，暴力精确检索反而更简单：不用维护索引，也不承担 recall 损失。

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索：只探索部分向量换取低延迟，召回率略低于精确检索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN stands for Approximate Nearest Neighbor search, which explores only part of the vectors to gain latency at slightly reduced recall.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种分层图索引，沿图上的邻居边逐步走近查询向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW is a hierarchical graph index that walks neighbour edges to navigate progressively closer to the query vector.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把向量空间切成若干分区，查询时只扫描离查询最近的几个分区。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF partitions the vector space into cells and scans only the few partitions nearest the query.

termDefinitions.meaning: 召回率：近似检索返回的结果里，真正属于 top-k 的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall is the fraction of the returned results that genuinely belong to the true top-k.

optionExplanations: 对：10 亿次距离计算是线性开销，和 100ms 预算差着数量级。
反了——精确扫描按定义就是最准的，近似才是拿准确度换延迟。
余弦相似度恰恰非常适合向量化批量计算，算力不是这里的卡点。
高维下距离依然有定义，只是区分度变弱，那是另一个问题。
optionExplanations_en: Right: a billion distance computations is linear cost and sits orders of magnitude above a 100ms budget.
Backwards — exact scanning is by definition the most accurate; approximation is what trades accuracy for latency.
Cosine similarity is in fact ideal for vectorized batch computation, so raw compute is not the blocker here.
Distance remains well defined in high dimensions; it just discriminates less, which is a separate concern.

scenario: 短视频推荐要在几分钟内跟上用户刚冒出来的兴趣，夜间批量重算向量已经太慢。
scenario_en: Short-video recommendations must follow a user's newly emerged interest within minutes, and a nightly batch re-embed is already too slow.
q: 在线更新时具体更新模型的哪一部分？
q_en: Which part of the model do you actually update online?
options: 每来一次用户互动，就把整个双塔模型的全部参数端到端重训一遍
冻结 encoder，只更新 embedding table
只重建向量索引，向量数值保持不变
把最近点击的物品 id 拼到向量末尾几维
options_en: Retrain every parameter of the two-tower model end to end on each interaction.
Freeze the encoder and update only the embedding table.
Rebuild only the vector index, leaving the vector values unchanged.
Append recently clicked item ids to the last few dimensions of the vector.
why: encoder 权重一动，全库向量都要重算才可比；查表那部分参数放参数服务器可以按行热更新，代价是要养一整套在线训练基础设施。
why_en: Touching encoder weights invalidates every stored vector, whereas the lookup parameters live on a parameter server and can be hot-updated row by row — the cost is standing up a whole online training stack.
tradeoff: 更新新鲜度 vs 要维护的在线训练基础设施
whenOtherWins: 如果内容和兴趣按天变化（长视频、商品目录），定时批量重算就够，省掉参数服务器这套复杂度。

termDefinitions.meaning: 专门存放并在线更新大规模模型参数（尤其是查表参数）的分布式服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A parameter server is a distributed service that stores large model parameters, especially lookup tables, and updates them online.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按实体 id 查向量的大查找表，每一行就是一个实体的向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding table is a large lookup table keyed by entity id, where each row is one entity's vector.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把输入特征映射成向量的网络部分，权重一变全库向量就要重算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The encoder is the network that maps input features into vectors; if its weights change, every stored vector must be recomputed.

optionExplanations: 全量重训是小时级 GPU 作业，根本赶不上“几分钟”的新鲜度目标。
对：只有查表参数在线动，冻结 encoder 保证全库向量仍然可比。
重建索引只是把老向量重新组织一遍，用户的新行为压根没进向量。
手工拼维度破坏了训练时学到的空间结构，点积分数不再有意义。
optionExplanations_en: A full retrain is an hours-long GPU job and cannot possibly hit a freshness target measured in minutes.
Right: only the lookup parameters move online, and freezing the encoder keeps every stored vector comparable.
Rebuilding the index merely reorganizes old vectors — the user's new behaviour never entered them at all.
Hand-appending dimensions breaks the space structure learned during training, so the dot-product score stops meaning anything.
